Free skills / Prompt book

The Free Prompt Book

21 tested prompts for everyday work, grouped by job. Copy one, paste it into a chat, add your material.

Download the PDF (172 KB, 40 pages)Read the prompts on the site

Free. No sign-up. Nothing to install.

How it works

  1. Pick the job and read the short note: what it does and what to have ready.
  2. Copy the prompt from the grey box into a new chat, then paste your own material under it.
  3. Read the answer before you use it. The prompts say what they could not check and leave gaps marked instead of guessing.

Each prompt was run on real data before it went in. They are tools, not guarantees, and nothing in the book is legal, tax or medical advice.

Prefer to install them?

The same jobs exist as installable skills that can fetch pages and run small scripts where your assistant allows. See the free skills, or install them all with npx skills add proskillpacks/skills. Not sure which route fits? Read skills, prompts or custom GPTs.
